SELECT DISTINCT TO_CHAR(S.COURSE_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS COURSE_DATE, TO_CHAR(P.PLAN_NO) AS PLAN_NO, P.COURSE_NAME_CODE, P.PERIOD_TIME, TRUNC(S.COURSE_DATE) AS SORT_DATE FROM EDU_TRAIN_SYLLABUS S JOIN EDU_PLAN_MANAGER P ON P.PLAN_NO = S.PLAN_NO WHERE S.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND S.ACTIVITY = 1 AND P.ACTIVITY <> 0 AND S.COURSE_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{yearMonth, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '01', 'YYYYMMDD') AND S.COURSE_DATE < ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(#{yearMonth, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), 1)
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EDU_BASIC_INFORMATION B JOIN EDU_FREE_EMPLOYEE F ON F.BASIC_NO = B.BASIC_NO WHERE B.PLAN_NO = S.PLAN_NO AND F.EMPID = #{empid, jdbcType=VARCHAR})
ORDER BY SORT_DATE, PLAN_NO

SELECT P.ISNOT_TEST, P.ISNOT_REPORT, (SELECT MAX(B.TRAIN_CONTENT) FROM EDU_BASIC_INFORMATION B WHERE B.PLAN_NO = P.PLAN_NO) AS TRAIN_CONTENT FROM EDU_PLAN_MANAGER P WHERE P.PLAN_NO = #{planNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND P.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
